phases.group: Source returns across several carrier cycles
rows: Two source turns in three carrier cycles
Four source turns in three carrier cycles
Five source turns in four carrier cycles
notes: The two-thirds-speed source returns with the carrier after three carrier cycles. Both start at zero; this shared return does not make the intervening curve simple.
The four-thirds-speed source also returns after three carrier cycles, but makes four turns rather than two. Equal repeat spans do not mean equal curves.
The five-fourths-speed source returns after four carrier cycles. Depth stays two and the finite note envelope stays unchanged.
phases.facts: For ratio p/q in lowest terms, q carrier cycles return both phases:2/3 and4/3 haveq3;5/4 hasq4. Wave is sin(theta+2sin(ratio theta)), common initial0; no spectral equality or loudness claim.
phases.message: phases comparisons keep exact choices silent and reversible
